title: From Silence to Speech: A Novel AI System for Speech Development for the Deaf Through Lip-Reading
summary: Huazhong University reports that 343 deaf users regained speech capabilities with AI-guided lip-reading practice. The chapter also claims threefold learning efficiency.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Huazhong University reports that 343 deaf users regained speech capabilities with AI-guided lip-reading practice. The chapter also claims threefold learning efficiency. These are the developers' aggregate claims. The chapter does not establish the duration of restored speech or provide independent confirmation of each participant's outcome.
purpose: Help deaf learners practice articulation and develop vocal communication.
developer: Huazhong University of Science and Technology
deployer: Participating rehabilitation centers and special schools

ratings.reason: The authors claim that 343 deaf users regained speech capabilities through the system. Restored communication supports depth 3 as reported, while duration and independent confirmation remain unknown.

ai_role.statement: Computer vision analyzes learners' articulatory gestures and supplies corrective visual feedback during lip-reading practice. The chapter attributes aggregate speech gains to this combined training process.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 3: From Silence to Speech: A Novel AI System for Speech Development for the Deaf Through Lip-Reading

produced_by: Causal conditions are not established separately in the extracted chapter.
must_hold: Client applications with video input and cloud inference
Practice materials and corrective feedback during articulation training

headline: AI lip-reading training reports restored speech

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
